title: Codestral Release
summary: Mistral AI introduced Codestral on May 29, 2024 as its first code model, an open-weight 22-billion-parameter model designed for code generation and fill-in-the-middle tasks.
significance: A dated release milestone for Mistral AI's specialized code-model family, with the original Codestral 2405 release documented under the Mistral AI Non-Production License.

verification.note: Mistral AI's first-party announcement is dated May 29, 2024 and introduces Codestral as its first code model, a 22B open-weight model for code generation. Mistral's official model documentation independently records May 29, 2024, the codestral-2405 identifier, 22B parameters, 32k context, and MNPL license. Mistral's same-day MNPL announcement states that Codestral was released that day under the new license. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, priority claim, or relationship edge is inferred.
